stem.text: Which statement about $\beta^{-}$ decay is correct?

A.text: A neutron changes to a proton in the nucleus and an electron and an antineutrino are emitted.

B.text: A neutron changes to a proton in the nucleus and an electron and a neutrino are emitted.

C.text: A proton changes to a neutron in the nucleus and an electron and an antineutrino are emitted.

D.text: A proton changes to a neutron in the nucleus and an electron and a neutrino are emitted.
